random-wheel

<用户自制> 随机转盘：把截图或选项做成可调速的动画转盘，随机抽选。 Pick one option with a real animated, speed-adjustable wheel from a screenshot or named choices. Use for random selection, 随机转盘, 抽一个, or choosing a course by chance.

GitHub source

When to use it

Use it to pick a course, activity, or another supplied option by chance. Speed changes the animation; a reroll creates a new draw.

“Randomly pick one of these options and show a wheel.”

What is included

Includes the Python renderer and HTML templates. Requires Python 3 and a modern browser, with no extra Python dependencies; produces offline HTML.

Ask naturally; if the client supports explicit invocation, select random-wheel。The client’s existing authority, authentication, and tool boundaries remain in force.
